messages.author: 1c6fdf69a26a38bf
messages.subject: Shiny Server Issues
parts:
Hi Team,

I am trying to run the shiny server but facing the below issues:

When i run the command #start shiny-server it is saying " shiny-server start/running"  but when i tried to access my sample applications through https://host IP:3838/sample/  it is not connecting and rendering the application in the browser.

When i run the command   #stop shiny-server it says "shiny-server stop/waiting"

shiny server config has the below code ->
run_as shiny;

server {
  listen 3838;

  location / {
    site_dir /var/shiny-server/www;
    log_dir /var/shiny-server/log;
    directory_index on;
  }
}

any help is appreciated!
